science.qualification: Color of a black body at the dayside brightness temperature 1,300 K measured in secondary eclipse in the JWST MIRI LRS band, 5.06 to 10.55 µm (Coy et al. 2026, ApJ Letters (arXiv 2604.11911 v2), brightness temperature from one eclipse 38 ± 11 ppm deep), uniform over the disc and lit by its star so the day side faces it. The planet is unresolved: no map is implied, and reflected starlight is not included. Its black-body color lies outside the sRGB gamut and is shown mixed with 2% white, the least that brings it inside, hue kept.

metadata.limbMeaning: The adopted source-radius opaque-sphere silhouette and prepared phase lighting define the limb; no atmospheric rim is inferred.
